results.title: DentalHQ Raises $1.1M to Revolutionize In-House Dental Membership Management | Signalbase
highlights:
DentalHQ Raises $1.1M to Revolutionize In-House Dental Membership Management | Signalbase
...
Funding news Published May 8, 2025
...
We are thrilled to announce that DentalHQ has successfully raised $1,100,000 in its latest funding round—a milestone that marks a significant step forward in revolutionizing dental care practices nationwide. DentalHQ is the innovative in-house membership platform uniquely designed for dentists and dental professionals to attract and retain fee-for-service patients while bypassing the complexities of traditional dental insurance. By empowering dentists to offer tailored membership plans, DentalHQ gives uninsured patients greater control over their dental care costs, directly addressing the major barrier of affordability that often keeps quality dental services out of reach.
...
This capital injection will be strategically invested in further enhancing our SaaS platform by developing new features that support custom membership plan creation, streamlined billing and reporting, and automated patient outreach. Additional funding will also bolster our integrated marketing services, patient financing tools, and expert consultation initiatives to help dental practitioners grow their patient base. With a proven track record, as evidenced by a 94.7% customer retention rate and the support of thousands of practitioners, DSOs, and dental professionals, DentalHQ is committed to fortifying the direct relationship between dentists and their patients while significantly driving practice revenue.
...
Our goal is to eliminate the obstacles that have historically hindered patient access to affordable dental care. With this funding milestone, DentalHQ is set to advance its mission of promoting overall oral health by establishing a more transparent, effective, and patient-centric model for dental care. We thank our investors and loyal users for believing in our vision as we continue to transform the way dental services are delivered and experienced.

highlights:
Raleigh, NC, August 12, 2025 -Inc., the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future, today announced that DentalHQ is one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, landing on their annual Inc. 5000 list. The list provides a data-driven snapshot of the most successful companies within the economy’s most dynamic segment—its independent, entrepreneurial businesses. Past honorees include Microsoft, Meta, Chobani, Under Armour, Timberland, Oracle, and Patagonia.

The platform offers plans for every patient, seamless PMS integration, guaranteed plan payments, and marketing tools like BusinessCONNECT and CommunityCONNECT—making it the most responsive, intuitive, and connected membership solution on the market.Today, DentalHQ serves practices nationwide, from solo offices to DSOs and multi-location groups, helping them increase patient loyalty, boost treatment acceptance, and automate administrative tasks so teams can focus on care, not paperwork. properties.name: DentalHQ
properties.description:
Introducing DentalHQ: the revolutionary in-house membership platform for dentists. Our platform empowers dentists to attract and retain fee-for-service patients while eliminating the hassles of dental insurance. With DentalHQ, you can provide uninsured patients with budgetary control over their dental care, reducing the #1 barrier to attracting uninsured patients: cost. 

Our platform, designed by a dentist, promotes overall patient health by removing barriers to oral healthcare and fosters a direct relationship between you and your patients. Our Saas application allows you to create custom dental membership plans, automate billing and reporting, and includes services to attract and retain new members. 

In addition to plan management, our platform offers patient financing tools, integrated marketing services, expert consultation, patient outreach, and new patient acquisition services, all designed to help you see more fee-for-service patients and increase practice revenue substantially. With a customer retention rate of 94.7%, our proven solutions have helped thousands of practitioners, DSOs, and dental professionals. Choose DentalHQ for the best value in in-house membership plan management.
